name: Cutout.pro
description_en:
Cutout.pro is an online collection of AI image/video tools, including background removal, retouching, enhancement, colorization and generation. The background-removal workflow offers automated separation followed by manual Erase & Restore and an editor for shadows, replacement backgrounds, crop and resize.

It fits preparing product cutouts or other visual assets, with web, desktop, plugin and API routes under separate conditions. Low-resolution previews/downloads and full-resolution paid credits are different. Image operations have different credit costs, and current price-page rollover/refund language does not fully align with the general contract.
description_zh:
Cutout.pro是一组在线AI图像/视频工具，包括去背景、修饰、增强、上色及生成。去背景先自动分离，再用Erase & Restore手动修正，并可编辑阴影、替换背景、裁切和尺寸。

它适合商品抠图等素材准备，网页、桌面、插件及API路线有不同条件。低分辨率预览/下载与付费全分辨率点数不同，不同图像操作耗点不同，当前价格页的结转/退款表述也未与通用合同完全一致。

core_features.explanation_en: Upload a photo, refine with Erase & Restore and choose transparent/replacement background output.
core_features.explanation_zh: 上传后以Erase & Restore修正，再选择透明/替换背景输出。

core_features.explanation_en: Background removal/retouch list one credit per image; selected enhancement/colorizer/passport/cartoon tools list two.
core_features.explanation_zh: 去背景/修饰每图1点，指定增强/上色/证件/卡通工具列2点。

core_features.explanation_en: The guide routes large jobs to desktop/API or Shopify; that does not establish unlimited web throughput.
core_features.explanation_zh: 指南把大批量引向桌面/API或Shopify，不证明网页吞吐无限。

sections.title_en: Remove, inspect and refine before downloading
sections.title_zh: 去背景后检查修正再下载
sections.en:
The [background guide](https://www.cutout.pro/remove-background) recommends a clear foreground, uploads by file/drag-and-drop or image URL, then Erase & Restore for corrections. Editor adds shadows, background colors/photos and crop/resize. Download JPG/PNG at the available quality. A transparent result needs a format that preserves alpha; a JPEG delivery and transparent PNG serve different purposes.

For a product catalog, inspect hair/fur, fine openings, reflective surfaces and the object’s color against the original. The FAQ warns that out-of-focus subjects and blurry or similarly colored edges can fail. It directs images beyond 4,000×4,000 to support for a customized solution, which is a threshold to confirm rather than proof every large image is accepted. Marketing claims about conversion rates and perfect edges were not independently tested.
sections.zh:
[去背景指南](https://www.cutout.pro/remove-background)建议前景清晰，可用文件、拖放或图片URL上传，再Erase & Restore修正。Editor加阴影、背景色/图及裁切/改尺寸，按可用质量下载JPG/PNG。透明结果需保留alpha的格式，JPEG与透明PNG用途不同。

商品目录应对照原图检查毛发、细孔、反光及主体颜色。FAQ提示失焦主体、模糊或相近色边缘可能失败，超过4,000×4,000需联系定制方案，这是待确认阈值，不证明所有大图可接收。转化率及完美边缘宣传未独立测试。

sections.title_en: Web editing, desktop and API are different jobs
sections.title_zh: 网页、桌面及API是不同流程
sections.en:
The page describes bulk desktop/API processing and advertises a desktop batch above 10,000 images; no such capacity was measured. An application team should verify endpoint size/rate limits, result formats and billing separately before automating. Shopify purchases are expressly described as nonrefundable in the background FAQ; do not apply a generic web refund banner to every sales channel.

A mobile FAQ says background removal is not available there while current navigation promotes mobile tools, so current mobile parity is unresolved. Also, video/generative-model products are separately listed and have their own pricing; image-removal credit arithmetic is not a rate for every model or video task. No desktop install, plugin, API or mobile flow was run.
sections.zh:
页面介绍桌面/API批处理，并宣传桌面可超10,000张，本文未测该容量。自动化前应逐端点核对尺寸/限流、格式和计费。去背景FAQ明确Shopify购买不退款，不能把通用网页退款横幅用于每个销售渠道。

移动FAQ称去背景尚不可用，但当前导航又推广移动工具，当前移动一致性未解决。视频/生成模型独立列出及定价，去背景点数不能作为所有模型/视频费率。未安装桌面、插件或执行API/移动流程。

sections.title_en: Preview access and paid operation counts
sections.title_zh: 预览访问与付费操作计数
sections.en:
The [image-price page](https://www.cutout.pro/image-pricing) offers ongoing previews and five signup credits; the background page also describes free low-resolution downloads. These are not unlimited full-resolution credits. It lists one credit/image for background removal and retouch, two for cartoon selfie, passport, enhancer and colorizer. Exact current variants/models need their own rate confirmation.

Displayed monthly subscriptions include 80 credits/$5,170/$9.90,300/$16.90,550/$29 and 1,000/$49. One-time packs include 30/$4.99,300/$39,900/$79 and 3,000/$199, with larger/custom options. Dollar currency, taxes and actual checkout were not verified. Paid packs are described as valid forever; subscription rollover is capped at five monthly allowances while active. The price widget’s NaN fragment is ignored rather than treated as a real rate.
sections.zh:
[图像价格页](https://www.cutout.pro/image-pricing)提供持续预览及5个注册点，去背景页还说明免费低分辨率下载，均非无限全分辨率点数。去背景/修饰每图1点，卡通头像、证件、增强及上色列2点，具体当前变体/模型仍需单独核价。

显示月订阅为80点/$5、170/$9.90、300/$16.90、550/$29、1,000/$49；一次性包有30/$4.99、300/$39、900/$79、3,000/$199及大档/定制。符号对应币种、税费及实际结账未核实。点数包称永久有效，订阅结转则限有效期内5倍月额度。组件NaN片段不作为实际费率。

sections.title_en: Rollover, billing and refund statements need reconciliation
sections.title_zh: 结转、计费及退款表述需核对
sections.en:
The price page advertises a fourteen-day money-back guarantee restricted to 50 downloads, flexible cancellation and five-times rollover. The [contract](https://www.cutout.pro/terms) instead says monthly credits expire at billing-cycle end and its withdrawal right ends once services have been used. These are materially different conditions, not an unconditional refund or settled credit-expiry promise. Obtain the applicable order terms for the actual plan.

The contract counts a photo as processed when a result is offered for download, even if it is not downloaded, and reserves interface blocking if more than 15%of requests fail. Therefore, a batch estimate should include attempted processing and input validation, not only files saved to disk. The exact failure billing and current threshold enforcement were not tested. No purchase, credit use or refund request was made.
sections.zh:
价格页宣传14天退款、限50次下载、灵活取消及5倍结转；[合同](https://www.cutout.pro/terms)却写月点账期末失效，且使用服务后撤回权结束。这些条件实质不同，不能当无条件退款或已解决的点数期限承诺，应取得实际订单条款。

合同还把结果可供下载即视为已处理，即使用户未下载，并保留失败请求超15%时阻断接口的权利。因此批量预算应计尝试处理和输入验证，不只算保存到磁盘的文件。失败计费及阈值执行未测，未购买、用点或申请退款。

sections.title_en: A limited SaaS license with tariff-dependent output rights
sections.title_zh: 有限SaaS许可与按资费决定的输出权利
sections.en:
The contract grants time-limited nonexclusive internal/own use of the software and makes commercial/noncommercial result rights depend on the chosen tariff. It permits selected own-app/API integration but not providing the API interface itself to third parties. This is proprietary SaaS, not an open-source grant or a blanket commercial license for every free preview. Users still need rights to source photos and depicted people/marks.

The terms also restrict specified uses, including AI training-data generation. Exact current privacy/retention, regional contract interpretation, API conditions and asset-specific rights remain unverified. Keep originals and permitted outputs, and obtain scope for sensitive/client images. No upload, edge-quality check, credit deduction, integration, access or recovery test was executed.
sections.zh:
合同授予限期非独占内部/自用软件许可，结果商用/非商用权取决于所选资费。可在指定自有应用/API集成，但不能把API接口本身提供第三方。这是专有SaaS，不是开源，也不为每个免费预览统一授权商用。源照片、人物及标志权利仍由用户负责。

条款还限制AI训练数据生成等指定用途。当前隐私/保留、地区合同解读、API条件及素材权利未完全核实。应保留原图和允许输出，并确认敏感/客户图片范围。未测试上传、边缘质量、扣点、集成、权限或恢复。
